notes: The rewind target is a parcel size minus a parcel-derived length, with no bound relating the two. GetDataSize() is the size fact and ReadInt32() is the subtrahend, so the subtraction is on a read position and its result can be negative.

position_underflow_positive plus one guard line binding the subtrahend below the size (pos < 0 || GetDataSize() < pos). The bound is on the operands of the subtraction itself, which is what the rule asks for; the subtraction expression is unchanged.

The same size-minus-length subtraction, consumed as a length and checked nonnegative instead of used as a read position. The rule is about rewinding a read position, not about size arithmetic in general, so no rewind raises nothing.
